cpmplus.tooltip.wizard: Creates animations that react to movement:\falling, running, turning, jumping, landing and more.
cpmplus.tooltip.peso: How long the part takes to react.\0 = instantly, 10 = very slowly.
cpmplus.tooltip.mola: How much it overshoots and swings back.\0 = none, 10 = a lot.
cpmplus.tooltip.forca: How sensitive it is to movement.\5 = normal, 10 = reaches the end with half the movement.
cpmplus.tooltip.limite: How far the animation goes.\10 = the whole animation, 5 = halfway.
cpmplus.tooltip.limiar: On/off layers only: how strong the movement\must be to switch the animation on. 5 = halfway.
cpmplus.tooltip.toggle: Creates a layer that switches on and off,\instead of a slider that follows the strength.
cpmplus.wizard.name: Name: %s
cpmplus.tooltip.create: Creates a new animation with this name.\Then add the frames: the first one is the rest pose.\Frames are spread evenly from 0%% to 100%%.
cpmplus.tooltip.apply: Renames the selected animation, keeping anything\after the #, and sets the interpolation so the\frames land in the right place.
cpmplus.trigger.esquerda.desc: Grows when strafing to the left
cpmplus.trigger.direita.desc: Grows when strafing to the right
cpmplus.trigger.pouso.desc: A jolt when hitting the ground
cpmplus.trigger.pulo.desc: A jolt at the moment of the jump
cpmplus.tooltip.fix: Switches every cplus_ animation in this model to\Trigonometric Single. It keeps the middle frame\exactly at 50%% and eases into every frame.
cpmplus.message.fix.done: %s animation(s) fixed. 50%% now lands exactly on the middle frame.
cpmplus.tooltip.emitter: Creates an invisible point that emits particles,\attached to the selected part.
cpmplus.tooltip.emitter.id: The particle's Minecraft name, like flame or smoke.\Any particle in the game works.
cpmplus.tooltip.emitter.qtd: Particles per second.\With landing or jump: particles each time.
cpmplus.tooltip.emitter.vel: How fast particles come out.\0 = they stay in place.
cpmplus.tooltip.emitter.esp: 0 = a thin jet above the point,\10 = in every direction.
cpmplus.tooltip.emitter.cor: Coloured dust only, as RRGGBB.\Example: ff8800 is orange.
cpmplus.emitter.help.rate: The amount follows the strength of the chosen movement.
cpmplus.emitter.help.burst: Emits a burst of particles on every landing or jump.
cpmplus.tooltip.emitter.create: Creates the point on the selected part and the\animation with the settings. If the selected part is\already a point, adds another emitter to it.
cpmplus.tooltip.emitter.apply: Changes the settings of the emitter selected\in the animation list.
cpmplus.message.emitter.select: First select the part the particles should come out of.
cpmplus.message.emitter.created: Point created and selected. Move it to where the particles should come out. They come out above the point: rotate it to change the direction. Hide the point in an animation to turn the emitter off.
cpmplus.message.emitter.added: Another emitter added to this point.
cpmplus.tooltip.bend: Marks the selected piece so it bends\in Emotecraft emotes: elbow, knee\or waist.
cpmplus.bend.intro: Makes the piece bend in Emotecraft emotes.
cpmplus.tooltip.bend.percent: 100 bends as much as the emote. 50 bends half,\good for a joint cube at the elbow.
cpmplus.bend.select: Select the piece that should bend first.
cpmplus.tooltip.bend.mark: Creates the bend animation (or uses the one\that exists) and puts the selected piece in it.
cpmplus.message.bend.created: Piece marked in the new animation %s. In game it bends with the emote. To see it in the editor, select the animation and use its test control.
cpmplus.message.bend.already: That piece is already in the animation %s.
